Messages.Author: kushiel
Messages.Body:
Storage Annex
Location. Put a card from your hand facedown (out of play) on this card when
you play it. You may look at the card at any time. During your master phase,
you may exchange a card in your hand for the card on this Storage Annex. If
the Storage Annex is stolen or burned, the card on it is stolen or burned as
well.

Do I replace the Storage Annex played (ie, redraw from my library) before
choosing which card to put on it, or does the "when you play it" text on SA
mean that I have to choose which card goes on it before redrawing? Thanks.

John Eno
Prince of Pittsburgh, PA
